# Han Zhang

> Computer science undergraduate in the Turing Class (honors program) at Zhejiang University, currently a visiting intern at HKUST in Hong Kong. Works on 3D/4D vision and embodied AI. Seeking PhD and research positions.

## Research

- Interests: 3D/4D representation learning, physical world modeling, and embodied world learning.
- Focus: structured, generalizable representations of geometry, motion and articulation; how dynamic environments change in response to actions; how embodied agents acquire and reuse knowledge through perception and interaction.

## Publications

- [FreeArtGS: Articulated Gaussian Splatting Under Free-moving Scenario](https://freeartgs.github.io/) — CVPR 2026. Hang Dai\*, Hongwei Fan\*, Han Zhang\*, Duojin Wu, Jiyao Zhang, Hao Dong (\* equal contribution). Reconstructs articulated objects from monocular RGB-D video under free-moving capture. Han's contributions: part segmentation, camera pose and joint estimation, and the FreeArt-21 dataset with reproducible evaluation. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.22102) · [Code](https://github.com/FreeArtGS/FreeArtGS)

## Experience

- HKUST, Division of Integrative Systems and Design — Visiting Intern, Sep 2026–present. Advisor: Prof. Yuan Liu. Structured latent representations for articulated objects.
- CUHK-Shenzhen, GAP Lab — Research Intern, May 2026–present. Advisor: Prof. Xiaoguang Han. Articulated 3D representations, disassembly/assembly datasets, VLM-based physical-property reasoning with VLA policies.
- PKU–Agibot Lab — Research Intern, Jul–Nov 2025. Advisor: Prof. Hao Dong. Co-developed FreeArtGS.

## Education

- Zhejiang University — B.Eng. in Computer Science, Turing Class (honors), expected June 2027.
